topic: Promote consumer-regression tests to required_tests so the worker must run them
lesson: A delegated worker self-verifies only against the task's required_tests + verify_commands, not the full suite. A regression in an out-of-scope consumer (e.g. board/story_detail crashing on run_state_path) is invisible to it and survives repeated re-delegation. When measurement finds such a regression, add the exact failing test to the frontier task's required_tests and re-delegate: a failing required test is feedback the worker cannot skip. Four re-delegations failed to land a 3-line guard until the board test was promoted to required.
